scope: Independent replication of the three open W077 hard findings on AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN at F2b rev12 (class-consistency, binding-hash integrity, citation-status honesty), plus two breadth extensions the W077 record noted or scoped out. Not a full-schema acceptance verdict and not a gate verdict.
summary: All three W077 findings independently reproduce at the same pinned hashes: (1) the declared F0 C0 conclusion quantifies over admissible (s,delta) pairs only while F2b D0 is a tagged union including r=smooth, and the conclusion records no index deferral although F0 H3 defers the data space to F2; (2) f0_binding declares consistency_evidence_sha256 675a99d0d25b while the named canonical file and the FROZEN rev28 pin both measure 9e335e9b; (3) five F2b l1_ledger_refs rows declare citation_status=verified_by_L1 against ledger rows whose own vocabulary is verification_status=abstract-read / review_status=not_independently_reviewed, with the token verified_by_L1 occurring 0 times in the ledger. Two extensions: the same citation_status drift covers 6 further rows in F1/F2a (W077 scoped its HF-03 to F2b), and the same index-domain divergence holds for the declared C2 taxonomy vs F2a D0 (recorded by W077-C-01, not adjudicated there). No W077 finding was refuted. Repair is one pass: align the two declared-F0 conclusions to D0-as-owned-by-F2, refresh the binding hash, and set the citation_status values to the ledger vocabulary in all three schemas.

w077_review_record.relation: target-of-replication; its three hard_failures were independently re-measured, not copied

hard_failures.finding: Independent confirmation at taxonomy 0abb9ed8a961 (line 346) and F2b 55d0a1ea9bda (lines 42, 52, 214): the declared F0 C0 conclusion reads 'For every admissible (s,delta) there is a comeager set G_{s,delta}...' and never names the smooth-with-decay branch; F2b D0 is 'a tagged disjoint union: r = smooth ... or r = (sobolev,s,delta)...' and both quantifiers.formal and conclusion.statement_formal bind 'forall r in D0'. F0 H3 defers the topology and weighted data spaces to F2 (owned_by=F2, unresolved=true) but the conclusion contains no deferral clause, so the two pinned statements of the same frozen class range over different index domains. My harness measured: f0_conclusion_has_smooth_branch=false, f0_conclusion_records_index_deferral=false, f0_H3_defers_data_space_to_F2=true, f2b_D0_has_tagged_smooth_branch=true, f2b_formal_binds_forall_r_in_D0=true.
hard_failures.falsifier: At the same pins: the finding is void if the taxonomy C0 conclusion contains the smooth-data branch or a recorded index-domain deferral, or if F2b D0 does not include r=smooth. A hash move of either artifact supersedes rather than falsifies it.

hard_failures.finding: Independent recomputation at F2b 55d0a1ea9bda line 308: f0_binding.consistency_evidence names artifacts/formulation/evidence/taxonomy_consistency.json and declares consistency_evidence_sha256=675a99d0d25b2b37c9b9e9b965aec1c1ff0e388d2665fd9247b58c04733eba48; the named file measures 9e335e9ba1bfcf777dc9e81816fcf1eda43ce37cef38db754a74649ea6c6fb9b, which is exactly the FROZEN revision 28 pin for that path. f0_binding.declared_f0_sha256 (0abb9ed8a961...) does match the live taxonomy, so the F0 binding itself is current; only the consistency-evidence pointer is stale. The binding's own rule requires a refresh and a re-run of the consistency check before any gate verdict.
hard_failures.falsifier: Declared consistency-evidence sha256 equals the measured canonical-path sha256 at the reviewed revision, or the named file is shown not to be the canonical consistency evidence; either voids W015-HF-02.

hard_failures.finding: Independent replication at ledger a1674f094979: l1_ledger_refs rows D-002 (line 295), T-301 (296), T-515 (297), T-528 (298), T-302 (299) declare citation_status=verified_by_L1. Each corresponding ledger row records verification_status=abstract-read and review_status=not_independently_reviewed with acceptance_authority 'astra-lead-literature (ledger author; author self-assessment, not a reviewer verdict)'. The token verified_by_L1 occurs 0 times in the 62-row ledger and no ledger row carries a citation_status field at all; the same schema sets provenance.citation_status=unverified (line 311). T-305 (citation_status: unresolved) is an honest downgrade and is excluded. This is a status overclaim in the schema, not evidence that any source is wrong.
hard_failures.falsifier: A ledger row for any of the five ids at the pinned ledger hash with an independent-verification status, or a project definition equating verified_by_L1 with abstract/API-level citation-audit verdicts; either voids W015-HF-03.

extension_findings.finding: The same citation_status=verified_by_L1 token appears on 6 further l1_ledger_refs rows outside F2b: F1 293-294 (T-204, T-208) and F2a 279-283 (T-401, T-402, T-514, T-520). Every matched ledger row is verification_status=abstract-read / review_status=not_independently_reviewed. Total across the frozen three-schema set: 11 rows (F1 2, F2a 4, F2b 5) against 0 occurrences of the token in the ledger. One repair pass should cover all three schemas; leaving F1/F2a unpatched would keep the same overclaim on the two sibling classes.

extension_findings.relation_to_w077: adjudicates the pattern W077-C-01 recorded but did not count as a finding
extension_findings.finding: The declared F0 C2 conclusion (research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml line 274) also quantifies over 'admissible (s,delta)' only, while F2a D0 (schemas/af_scc_c2_vacuum.yaml line 52) is the same tagged union including r=smooth and F2a binds 'forall r in D0' (lines 42, 212). The C2 H3 likewise defers the data space to F2 with no deferral in the conclusion. So the index-domain divergence is bilateral (C0 and C2 pairs), not an F2b-only defect; a single repair covering both declared-F0 conclusions closes it.
extension_findings.falsifier: The taxonomy C2 conclusion names the smooth branch or a recorded index deferral, or F2a D0 lacks r=smooth.
